title: Learn steps 1 and 2 of The Earl of Erroll

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher demonstrates the steps clearly and provides verbal instructions for each movement. She breaks down the dance into smaller, manageable segments and practices them with the students.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the dance and explains the need for four bars of chorus.
The teacher breaks down the chorus step by step.
The teacher practices the chorus with music.
The teacher puts step 1 and 2 together.

steps_taught.name: Chorus
steps_taught.description: A series of hops, points, and brushes.

steps_taught.name: Step 1
steps_taught.description: A series of hops, points, and a single step.

steps_taught.name: Step 2
steps_taught.description: A series of hops, points, and a double step.

what_works: The teacher breaks down the steps into smaller, manageable segments.
The teacher provides clear verbal instructions for each movement.
what_hinders: The teacher does not provide any visual aids or diagrams to help students understand the steps.

quotes.text: Step one is start with the right foot.
Step two is simply double right and left.
So now we'll put one and two together.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands in front of the camera and demonstrates the steps.
The teacher performs the chorus step.
The teacher performs the chorus step with music.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses a combination of verbal instructions and physical demonstration to teach the steps.
